trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: this pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Treat it as the finish line, not a job. The plan in this guide runs story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger questlines and the leftover miscellaneous trophies — the platinum lands at the end of that cleanup. Sources: Push Square, Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this pops within your first session just by playing the story. No preparation, no choice to get wrong. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that can be missed elsewhere — the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) — then move on. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 2's story missions. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Sources: Push Square, Exophase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 3's story missions. From this chapter on, Andy's and Tyrone's side questlines open up — start them when their icons appear rather than leaving them all for after the story. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 4's story missions. This chapter unlocks the optional mission that opens the eight large bank vaults, which Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist both need — do that mission when it appears. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish the final story mission. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida, and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, so the real platinum grind starts here, not ends here. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Just play the story in order; it pops when the mission ends. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. No side requirement — the mission itself is the trophy. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story; it pops at the mission's end. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story progress only — nothing to prepare. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. The airport area you learn here is the same one Catch Me if You Can uses later, so note the layout. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. This is the last of the mission-named story trophies; after it, only the final mission trophy remains. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the heart of the platinum. After the story, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion checklist. You do NOT need everything: the checklist asks for selected portions — for example 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied — but it does need every robbery type, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range golds, all 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Work from the in-game checklist itself, top to bottom, and check the Roadmap tab here for the full numbers. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 and about 200 hours. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. The four types are Stunt Jumps (130), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25). Stunt Jumps have extra challenges attached that you do not need for this trophy. Find discovered spots on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or finish anything — one try of each counts. Most of these pop naturally while you sample Leonida during the story; deliberately try the ones you have not touched yet and this pops. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some are locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map. Track progress at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this is not optional for the platinum. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones. Note the 100% checklist separately wants all 42 Drone Time Trials finished across these same 14 locations — winning the race and clearing the time trials are different jobs. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twice does not count twice — you need 20 distinct ones out of the 40 on the map. Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most race spots let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating and buy upgrades at Mod Shops first. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, so keep racing past 20. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area on your map until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod — if you do not own one yet, hijack one in the area. Beat Cal's challenge and the trophy pops. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four video games in Leonida, and three of them are on the TV at home, so this is one of the cheapest trophies in the set — sit down, finish a game, done. It also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's questline, ending with the final mission. Andy's five quests are Lucia-only and open from Chapter 3. Do them as they appear — Andy stays available in free roam, so this is not missable, just easy to forget. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes. Kenton asks you to clear seven shipwrecks, and his strand opens in Chapter 1. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch mid-story but is back in free roam after the ending, so finish the wrecks whenever you can. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. Billy's five quests run out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub and open from Chapter 2. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. These are the wandering side characters marked across Leonida — each strand is a short chain of its own. The five named character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies; this one counts the other stranger strands. Mop these up in the cleanup stage after 100%. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. Randy hands you a Wish List of 16 cars to deliver, and his strand opens from Chapter 3. Deliver all 16, then play his final mission. Keep an eye out for Wish List cars while driving around — noting rare spawns as you go saves a long hunt later. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, opens from Chapter 3, and involves destroying the Kitty Litter labs before his final mission. Track the lab locations as you find them so the last mission is a short trip, not a search. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots. The catch: early in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and finish the balcony meditation. That balcony is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and you cannot repeat it after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — so just do it. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation plays. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find spots on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18, but this trophy needs all 18. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is Jason-only. The official description is short and the exact animal is still being confirmed by the guide sites — gamemapa flags it as unconfirmed — so check Bret's strand in-game and do not trust a single named animal from a forum post until two guides agree. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your sets. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this trophy falls out of the same hunt — keep collecting past three. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it). Scannable spots are landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23), plus No Flusher tags. Scan everything unfamiliar as you travel — vehicles count too for Whip It Good, but this trophy needs locations. Check progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges. Challenges are skill goals listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges — open that menu any time to see each requirement. The 100% checklist needs 70, so pick the 70 easiest and skip the 10 nastiest; this trophy pops at 50 on the way. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape the heat zone. The easiest escape the guides report is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and it unlocks once you leave the red zone. It also pops on its own often — robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star level. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — do not let the Wanted Level clear between shops. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this. The trophy is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not fire at once. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app. This should happen naturally across the story, and you can check what you have found under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning everything new you see. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — pick gang members at their illegal operations instead. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and fly away. The easiest airliner the guides report is docked at terminals E3/E4. It unlocks once you are about 1 km away from the airport — get clear, stay airborne, and it pops. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method yet. The official description is a joke line, not an instruction, and the guides do not agree on how this pops: KeenGamer's reading is to steal a Rhino tank and use it in combat, while gamemapa points to a tank at Mile Zero Air Station. Neither is confirmed. Do not chase this on a single report; wait until two guides agree, and do not trust a video that shows no trophy pop. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without triggering detection. You need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3 — do not attempt this early. Plan the approach, cut the alarms quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. There are eight vaults in total, and they open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 — do that mission when it appears. Each vault robbery instantly gives you a 4-star Wanted Level, so plan your escape route before you go in (see Hot Together for the tunnel trick). The 100% checklist needs all eight. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — hit one, grab the cash, and break away before the police box you in. It pops once you are clear, and it counts toward the robbery totals the 100% checklist wants. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Drive, fly and sail everywhere — the map fills in as you travel, and this pops once the last patch of fog is gone. Pair it with the WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery while you roam, since the same trips feed three trophies at once. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 Illegal Operations in Leonida, so you have plenty of choice — one per gang is all this trophy asks. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops early on that longer hunt. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method yet. The official description sounds simple — a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view — but the exact trigger is still unknown: gamemapa and KeenGamer both list it among the unsolved hidden trophies. Do not follow a how-to that cannot show the trophy popping. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method yet. The description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but the exact method is still unconfirmed in every guide checked — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed and gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. Treat any claimed method as a rumour until two guides agree. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the three key valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — and escape. The guides agree on the target: take all three valuables, then lose the police. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the likely reading is unproven. KeenGamer's reading is to maximise the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia, and gamemapa adds the tip to train at the gym together so progress doubles — but neither guide confirms it pops the trophy. Train together if you like; do not call this one solved until a guide shows the pop. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Your profile moves with almost everything you do in Leonida — crimes, jobs, choices — so this is a volume trophy, not a skill one. It builds up across the whole platinum run; by the time you finish the robbery and challenge totals, you will be most of the way there. Sources: Push Square, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — only an unverified likely reading exists. The description hints at a second attempt at something, but no guide has confirmed what. KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. Do not chase guesses. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method yet. The description hints at something strange, and that is all anyone knows: KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. If a claim cannot show the trophy popping, ignore it. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — only an unverified likely reading exists. KeenGamer's reading is a melee drive-by elimination, and the precise method is still being confirmed; gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. The description is the only solid fact. Sources: Push Square (description), KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them steadily as you play and the total climbs. The 100% checklist also needs $250,000 of Marked Bills fenced, so this trophy and the checklist move together — fence everything you steal. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer, gamemapa.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, food, gear, anything. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. You will spend far more than this on garages and gear across a platinum run, so it usually pops on its own. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each garage adds one parking spot, which also helps On the Spot. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive any vehicle to a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop and register it there; the fee varies with the vehicle's value. You need empty parking spots to register, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) if you run out. Registered vehicles can be delivered to you by Scooter Bros for a small fee. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: On the Spot
